unit.why: A legend about Nahmanides (Ramban) being drawn to kabbalah by an old practical kabbalist who escaped burning: a pre-Hasidic hagiographic tale.

stories.start_quote: שבחי אדונינו מורינו ורבן של כל ישראל
stories.end_quote: עד שיצא ראש החכמים בדורו על זאת החכמה
stories.summary_en: Nahmanides, a physician and philosopher who disdained kabbalah, refused to intercede for an old kabbalist sentenced to burning on a false charge of visiting a brothel. The sage, saved by practical kabbalah when a donkey was burned in his place, appeared at the Ramban's Sabbath kiddush. This persuaded the Ramban to study kabbalah.
